name: Archer-to-LossDB Control Failure Feed
description: Monthly batch export of control failure events from Archer to LossDB for correlation with operational loss data.

name: Archer-IssuesPortal Issue Sync
description: API-based weekly sync of issue status between Archer's issues module and IssuesPortal. Approximately 15% of updates are missed due to field mapping gaps.

name: Archer-to-Reporting Hub RCSA Feed
description: Daily batch feed of RCSA assessment data, control ratings, and risk scores from Archer to the Risk Reporting Hub.

name: Piedmont-to-Archer Reconciliation Export
description: Manual quarterly reconciliation export from Piedmont to Archer. Sandra Williams performs the data comparison and flags discrepancies.

name: LossDB-to-Reporting Hub Loss Feed
description: Daily batch feed of operational loss data from LossDB to Risk Reporting Hub. Carries a 3-5 business day reconciliation lag requiring manual bridging.

name: IssuesPortal-AuditTrack Bi-directional Sync
description: Bi-directional API integration ensuring audit findings flow from AuditTrack into IssuesPortal and remediation status flows back.

name: KRI Hub-to-Archer Threshold Feed (Broken)
description: Monthly batch feed of KRI threshold data from KRI Hub back to Archer. Three of eight feeds broken since Q3 platform upgrade. Christine Lee manually gap-fills.

name: Archer-to-KRI Hub KRI Data Feed
description: Monthly batch export of KRI definitions and threshold values from Archer to the KRI Hub SQL backend.

name: Change Log to Change Risk Tool Manual Bridge
description: Manual dual-entry of all change requests into both Change Log and Change Risk Tool. Consumes 2.0 FTE with 15-20% transcription error rate.

name: NPA-to-Change Risk Tool Approval Flow
description: API integration triggering change risk assessment in Change Risk Tool when a new product is approved in the NPA System.

name: Vendor Risk-to-NPA Assessment Feed
description: API-based feed of vendor risk assessment scores and due diligence results from Vendor Risk Platform to NPA System for new product evaluations.

name: Scenario-to-LossDB Annual Output
description: Annual batch export of scenario analysis outputs from the Scenario Workbench to LossDB for capital model calibration.

name: AuditTrack-to-IssuesPortal Finding Push
description: API push of new audit findings from AuditTrack into IssuesPortal for enterprise-wide tracking and remediation.

name: LossDB-to-Archer Loss Event Linkage
description: Weekly batch linking loss events in LossDB to corresponding control records in Archer for root cause tracking.

name: Reporting Hub Dashboard Metrics Feedback
description: Monthly feedback of aggregated dashboard metrics from Risk Reporting Hub to Archer for executive risk appetite monitoring.

name: KRI Hub-to-Reporting Hub Dashboard Feed
description: Monthly batch feed of KRI breach summaries and trend data from KRI Hub to Risk Reporting Hub for the CRO dashboard.

name: Scenario-to-Reporting Hub Stress Results
description: Annual export of stress test and scenario analysis results from Scenario Workbench to Risk Reporting Hub for board reporting.

name: Archer-to-Piedmont Migration Sync
description: Deprecated manual sync used during the Archer migration to keep Piedmont updated. Still performed quarterly by Sandra Williams as a safety net.
